name: render-test-does-not-cover-done-status
body: The render unit test's fixture only exercises status = "pending" (the shared task_recs builder's fixed status), so the [x] done checkbox branch of render_phase_tasks is not asserted by this test, and no other test in the file covers it. Limit: the done-status render branch is unasserted. Upgrade when render needs its done branch proven: extend task_recs to set a done status, or add a fixture carrying a done task.
